# Milestone 01 Simulink Models

## Editable models

- [arduino_interfacing.slx](arduino_interfacing.slx)
- [milestone1.slx](milestone1.slx)

These models relate to Arduino Mega sensor and servo experiments described in the [Milestone 01 report](../reports/Milestone1_Group18%20(1).pdf). The project used MATLAB and Simulink 2026a with Arduino support.

## Generated files

This folder also contains `.elf`, `.hex`, `.eep`, `.slxc`, `slprj/`, and `milestone1_ert_rtw/` outputs from Simulink code generation and deployment. These are build artifacts, **not** independently authored source code. They have been preserved as uploaded; new generated outputs are ignored by the repository's Git ignore rules.

Opening the models may require the appropriate MathWorks support packages and compatible hardware configuration.
